segments.text:
proposition 1 THe ſaith whereby
Moſes parents were moued to preſerue him, might as well be in reſpect of the promiſe made of old vnto the fathers, as alſo particularlie to themſelues.

proposition 2
Moſes by killing of the Aegyptian ſinned not, but was obedient to the inſtinct of the holie Ghoſt.
proposition 2 Although the father in lawe of Moſes were commonlie counted a prieſt, yet might it well be, that he was a prince in Madian.
proposition 4 The people of God, which was to be deliuered from the calamitie of Aegypt, cried vnto God, being not onelie mooued with a naturall gréefe, but ſtirred vp by repentance.
